changes: Tracked the recovery-runner experiment harness CODE under experiments/recovery-runner/ (3 runners run-recovery/a2prime/ablation, per-task fixtures for eval-expr/median/parse-range/text-stats, 2 generic injections) plus a README; excluded the 14 .jsonl run-record data files (they live in the companion paper repo Proofbound-AI/paper).
usage: git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner now lists 33 code files + README and zero .jsonl; to re-verify a task, copy its reference-solution.mjs to solution.mjs and run acceptance.mjs + ground-truth.mjs.
expectedOutcome: The harness code is version-controlled + gate-reviewed; each task reference-solution passes its acceptance + hidden ground-truth; no .jsonl tracked.
actualTranscript: 33 files tracked, 0 .jsonl; fixture self-consistency all PASS (eval-expr 20/9, median 8/8, parse-range 11/12, text-stats 6/5); 3 claude review lanes PASS + codex host-2 SHIP, 0 findings; full npm test green.
outcomeDiff: expected == actual: code tracked + reviewed, data excluded, fixtures self-consistent.
limitations: The 14 .jsonl run-records are intentionally not tracked here (they are experiment data in the paper repo). The runner end-to-end invokes the host CLI (claude -p); only fixture self-consistency was verified in-gate.
pitfalls: Two injection mechanisms coexist: eval-expr uses a drop-in payload-subtle.mjs while median/parse-range use inject()-module payloads (overfit/subtle-wrong-output.mjs) — the latter are NOT drop-in solutions and will fail acceptance if copied directly as solution.mjs.
